item.title: The Physics of Randomness: How Plinko Works
item.description: The classic game Plinko appears to be simple: players drop a ball onto a board, the ball bounces off a few pegs, and then lands in a slot. But beneath this simple game lies a complex mix of probability, motion, and chaos. If you know how the game works and how Plinko boards are designed, you can understand why the outcomes look random — and why they almost always seem to be fair.

item.title: Planning a DIY Plumbing Project: Tools and Supplies Homeowners Actually Need
item.description: For many U.S. homeowners, tackling a small plumbing project has become less intimidating than it used to be. With better access to information and professional-grade plumbing supplies online, DIY repairs like replacing a shutoff valve, installing a new faucet, or running a short PEX line are now realistic weekend projects. The key isn’t rushing in—it’s planning properly and choosing the right tools and materials from the start.
